facts.authority: Alabama Department of Revenue
facts.note: Act 2025-334, operating level WITHHOLDING: nonresidents with <=30 AL days working in more than one state whose home state has a similar exclusion or no PIT (list as of 2026-10-01: AK, FL, GA, IL, IN, LA, MT, NV, NH, SD, TN, TX, WA, WV, WY). At 31+ days all AL income of the year taxable. Athletes/entertainers/public figures excluded.
